scope: fixed source-held-out HQ-VSR val32, all presetseeds42/43, own formal8192-step no-reference outputs only

protocol.aggregation: all seeds arithmeticmean within video, then equal video weights; ratios first formed within video; separate valid/null counts
protocol.image_quantization: lossless float32 RGB[0,1] -> np.rint(rgb*255) clip[0,255] uint8; no MP4 decode
protocol.gray: cv2.cvtColor RGB2GRAY on uint8 RGB, OpenCV integer color conversion; no resize/crop

laplacian.variance: populationvariance over all spatial pixels per original frame, then frame arithmeticmean
laplacian.energy: mean(square(laplacian)) over all spatial pixels per frame, then frame arithmeticmean
laplacian.units: squared 8-bit grayscale intensity increments under the selected discrete Laplacian kernel

protocol.adjacent_rgb_change: mean absolute lossless RGB[0,1] difference over all channels/pixels for each original pair0-1 through7-8; then pairmean; no flow compensation
protocol.saved_perceptual_change: saved LPIPS prediction/GT temporal distances from original TecoGAN retained pairs2-3,3-4,4-5,5-6; meanpred/meanGT ratio, no recomputation or renaming of tLP
protocol.limits: These are descriptive texture/change magnitudes, not quality scores. A ratio near1 does not establish fidelity; lower values do not alone establish blur/stillness; texture hallucination, geometric/photometric changes, noise and frame-dependent content all affect them. No threshold/group/model selected from these results. Single training seed; no uncertainty or perceptual judgments claimed.

loader_validation: vsr.summarize_saved.load_saved_result validates completedv2 originalRGB/perceptual/source/noise and per-output SHA bindings before measurements
